svg.aria-label: How the dataset is built: 57 zip files from the FFIEC and CFPB, recorded in a SHA-256 manifest, are staged to text Parquet with raw line counts recorded. The lar, core and historic steps run typed SQL generated from schema.py one year at a time; the lenders, fdic and complaints steps add the FDIC BankFind institutions and 78 quarters of financials, matching RSSD ids to FDIC certificates and complaint names to LEIs. The result is six Parquet tables, checked by validate with 630 checks.
